notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello all!

Astra Hunter Zosma has been updated to Version 1.0.6. This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you can permanently lose the ship in Chapter 5 if you lose in a normal battle under specific circumstances.
[*]Relocated the lever and the NPC that moves the ship in the harbor to the east side of the map. You may now talk to this NPC to retrieve the ship if it is still missing.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello all!

Astra Hunter Zosma has been updated to Version 1.0.5. This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

BALANCE CHANGES
[list]
[*]Box Botherer X is now weak to fire like its normal counterpart.
[/list]

BUG FIXES:
[list]
[*]The AP and Chain Counter now clear from the screen at the end of battle.
[*]Made the requirements to "Create a Chain of X or more" read as "Create a Physical/Magic Chain of X or more" in boss fights that include the Protect mechanic, as items were not intended to fulfill it.
[*]Fixed a bug where no map music would play if you fell in battle and your last save point was on 2F.
[*]Fixed some wall tiles being walkable in the final area.
[*]Minor text fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello all!

Astra Hunter Zosma has been updated to Version 1.0.4. This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

NOTABLE CHANGES: 

[list]
[*] Enemies will now use normal Attack animations that are more consistent with their appearance. For example, enemies holding swords will use slashing animations and those with staves or unarmed will use striking animations.
[*] The enemy skills Double Cut and Triple Cut now have equivalent skills Double Strike and Triple Strike and are used by enemies without bladed weapons.
[*] In Chapter 1, the Least Important Character in the Game now reminds you to equip new weapons and armor that you buy or find, making them slightly more important (but still the least important).
[*] Removed the unused "Neutral" element from the Status menu, which nothing in the game granted bonuses to.
[/list]


BUG FIXES:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where elemental resistances would not add correctly if granted from multiple sources. For example, having the Companion wear an Element Ring while also having points invested in Element Resist should now grant the correct bonus.
[*] Fixed some enemy attacks not being considered physical attacks when they should be.
[*] Fixed several weapons and armors:
[*] Magic Foil and Dragon Hood should now increase stats by their intended amounts.
[*] Steel Blade should no longer reduce Zosma's SPD by 8.
[*] Minor graphical fixes for some field sprites.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello all!

Astra Hunter Zosma has been updated to Version 1.0.3. This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*] The boss of Expanding Void Part 6 should now have the correct battle background.
[*] Changed the formula for the amount of SP restored by Focus Shards. They will now restore 1 + (Chain Bonus% / 20) SP. This was changed due to a bug with the previous formula, where the amount restored would only be affected by Item Chains and ignored all other Chain types.
[*] It should no longer be possible to get the blocks stuck on the blue mushroom puzzle in Chapter 2 and box yourself in.
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] Minor mapping fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello all!

Astra Hunter Zosma has been updated to Versions 1.0.1. This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

- Added a note to the Betwixt's library telling you how to speed up cutscenes by holding "Z".
- If you retry certain scripted battles in Chapter 3 after losing, the correct encounter should now play.
- Minor mapping fixes.
- Added a very special boy to the credits.
